text:
Priya (Design): Quick copy check — we have a new confirmation modal when a user disables automatic model fallback. Current header says: "Disable automatic fallback?" Feels vague.
Alex (PM): Agreed. Users might think it's about routing. We should call out the impact (latency/cost/availability).
Jordan (Eng): Also important: disabling fallback can increase error surface if primary model is rate-limited. Maybe warn about automatic retries/fallback being disabled.
Priya (Design): Draft suggestion: "Disable automatic model fallback
This will stop automatic switching to alternative model variants when the primary model is unavailable. Your requests may fail or be slower." Too long?
Sam (SRE): I like the clarity. Suggest a shorter single-line summary for mobile: "Stop auto-fallback — requests may fail if the primary model is unavailable."
Maya (Docs): If we use "model variants" we should link to the docs. Can we add a small inline "Learn more" that opens the routing doc?
Priya (Design): Yep — propose adding a subtle secondary link below the description: "Learn more about fallback and routing". Also thinking about button labels: primary = "Disable fallback" (destructive), secondary = "Cancel".
Jordan (Eng): Button names fine. Make primary color red. Also add a checkbox: "I understand this may increase errors" for extra safety?
Alex (PM): Checkbox might be extra friction for advanced users — can we gate it only for orgs with SLA? But that's product complexity. For v1 let's keep it optional.
Priya (Design): Accessibility nits: a11y-bot flagged that the description length needs an aria-describedby target and focus should land on the modal heading. a11y-bot: "Heading must be H2, focus trap enabled, and link text must be descriptive."
a11y-bot: Please ensure the link reads "Read about model fallback behavior" rather than just "Learn more" when read by screenreaders.
Sam (SRE): Also ensure the audit log captures the toggle event: `auto_fallback_disabled` with actor and org.
Maya (Docs): I'll prep the routing doc snippet and suggested link text. Proposed link label: "Read about model fallback behavior and failover".
Priya (Design): Final microcopy proposal — modal body (two lines): "Disable automatic model fallback
This stops automatic switching to alternative model variants when the primary model is unavailable. Requests may fail or experience higher latency.
[Read about model fallback behavior and failover]
Primary button: "Disable fallback" (destructive)
Secondary button: "Cancel"
Small passive note under buttons: "Admins can re-enable fallback in Settings > Routing."
Jordan (Eng): Looks good. One API note: client SDKs treat this as an org-level flag, so language should reflect that (maybe "This will disable fallback for this workspace").
Priya (Design): Good catch — update line to: "This disables fallback for this workspace."
Alex (PM): ✅ Let's ship this copy. Priya, can you push the Figma update and open a tiny PR for translations? Maya, can you add the linked doc and verify link slug? Jordan/Sam, add telemetry and a11y checks to the checklist.
Priya (Design): Will do — I'll post the Figma link here when ready. :thumbsup:
Maya (Docs): I'll post the doc link and suggested slug by EOD.
Jordan (Eng): I'll add telemetry and a short migration note to the config spec.
Sam (SRE): I'll add the oncall playbook note about increased errors after disabling fallback.
Priya (Design): Thanks everyone — closing thread once PR/figma/doc links are up.
